Gladstone, Oregon

Junk removal in Gladstone

Gladstone is a small town wedged between the Clackamas and Willamette rivers, about sixteen road miles from our base, in Zone 2. Many of its homes are older single story houses on quiet streets, with detached garages and long back yards.

Riverside living brings yard work, and Gladstone jobs often include piles of branches and brush after a storm along with the usual household items. We also clear out homes for families handling an estate, where everything has to go and the timing matters. We can coordinate with an estate sale company so the leftovers go the day after the sale ends.

Gladstone questions

Good to know

Can you come the day after an estate sale in Gladstone?

Yes. Book that day and send photos once the sale ends, so we can bring the right size truck for what is left.

Do you take branches after a windstorm?

Yes. Cut them to a size two people can carry and pile them by the street or driveway. Each pile counts as a yard debris pile in the quote.

Is there a travel charge to Gladstone?

Yes. Gladstone is in our zone 2, so travel adds $25.00 per visit to the load price. It is shown in your price before you book.

Which Gladstone ZIP codes do you cover?

All of these: 97027. Type yours in the quote and the price includes travel.
